description: Change an existing BeautyOS member role/profile/calendar. own-schedule requires role=staff and an existing staffId. standard staff has broader client access. This does not restore revoked access or send email. Requires members.manage and beautyos.members.write. Returns a saved change ID with exact recipient, role, calendar and email effects. No access changes or email before confirmation. Show the effects and call beautyos_apply_change only after explicit approval. Ownership changes and self-role changes are forbidden; external CRM/legacy permissions are unchanged. If a receipt reports accessSaved=true and deliveryError, tell the user the invitation email failed and propose a new confirmed resend; replaying the original operation never resends.
name: beautyos_member_update_prepare
title: Change team access
